shellCommands.command:
set -e
echo "--- home (empty) ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3999/ | grep -E 'Currently reading|Finished|Nothing in progress'
echo "--- add a book ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} redirect:%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3999/books --data 'title=Piranesi&author=Susanna+Clarke&notes=Loved+it&finished=true'
echo "--- add a second (reading) ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} redirect:%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3999/books --data 'title=The+Tale+of+Despereaux&author=Kate+DiCamillo&notes=chapter+1'
echo "--- home (populated) ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3999/ | grep -oE 'Piranesi|The Tale of Despereaux|Susanna Clarke|Kate DiCamillo'
echo "--- data file ---"
cat /tmp/books_smoke.json

rm -f /tmp/books_smoke.json
BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/books_smoke.json PORT=3999 node server.mjs &
SRV=$!
sleep 0.5

echo "--- add finished book ---"
REDIR=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{redirect_url}" -X POST http://localhost:3999/books --data 'title=Piranesi&author=Susanna+Clarke&notes=Loved+it&finished=true')
echo "$REDIR"
BOOKID=$(basename "$REDIR")

echo "--- add reading book ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3999/books --data 'title=The+Tale+of+Despereaux&author=Kate+DiCamillo&notes=chapter+1'

echo "--- data file (decoded?) ---"
cat /tmp/books_smoke.json

echo "--- detail page ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:3999/books/$BOOKID" | grep -oE 'Piranesi|Susanna Clarke|Loved it|Finished|Share|localhost:3999/books/[0-9a-f-]+' | head -8

echo "--- toggle reading->finished ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3999/books/$BOOKID/toggle" --data 'finished=true'

echo "--- validation: empty title ---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3999/books --data 'title=&author=Nope' | grep -oE 'Title is required'

echo "--- 404 ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3999/books/nonexistent

kill $SRV 2>/dev/null
wait $SRV 2>/dev/null

rm -f /tmp/books_smoke2.json
echo "--- add finished book ---"
REDIR=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{redirect_url}" -X POST http://localhost:3998/books --data 'title=Piranesi&author=Susanna+Clarke&notes=Loved+it&finished=true')
echo "$REDIR"
BOOKID=$(basename "$REDIR")
echo "--- add reading book ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3998/books --data 'title=The+Tale+of+Despereaux&author=Kate+DiCamillo&notes=chapter+1'
echo "--- data file (decoded?) ---"
cat /tmp/books_smoke2.json
echo "--- detail page ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:3998/books/$BOOKID" | grep -oE 'Piranesi|Susanna Clarke|Loved it|Finished|Share|localhost:3998/books/[0-9a-f-]+' | head -8
echo "--- toggle finished->reading ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST "http://localhost:3998/books/$BOOKID/toggle" --data 'finished=false'
echo "--- validation: empty title ---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3998/books --data 'title=&author=Nope' | grep -oE 'Title is required'
echo "--- 404 ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3998/books/nonexistent

echo "--- home after restart (same data file) ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3997/ | grep -oE 'Piranesi|The Tale of Despereaux|Susanna Clarke|Kate DiCamillo|Currently reading|Finished'
echo "--- the toggled book should now be in 'reading' ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3997/ | sed -n '/Currently reading/,/<\/div>/p' | grep -oE 'Piranesi'

echo "--- home after restart ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3997/ | grep -oE 'Piranesi|The Tale of Despereaux|Susanna Clarke|Kate DiCamillo|Currently reading|Finished|Nothing in progress'
echo "exit: $?"
